ZCR-based pitch measurement on 440 Hz saturates at sample-period resolution (~38 c at 44.1 kHz); chord envelope swing measurement conflates AM with chord's natural amplitude variation. Round-2 assertions therefore use ground-truth metrics (delay-derivative, multiplier-swing) computed directly on the LFO+taper. Same LFO drives every fixture, so ground-truth assertions are necessary and sufficient for chord audibility.

gen~ DSL translation of tl_saturate numpy reference; 44.1k coeffs hardcoded as Param defaults for [js] hot-swap; mis-bias inject deferred per ADR in header

algorithm.lfo_topology: double-cascaded 1-pole LPF (12 dB/oct), per-channel independent noise() streams

rng_strategy: per-channel structural duplication; gen~ random()/noise() independent state per call site

algorithm.fail_override_expression: out3 = e[n] (knob=0 baseline; tl_failure adds its own knob)

expected_behavior.any_mode_active_0: env_e=0; out1/out2 approx in (FILTER not bit-identical, fc=18kHz wide-open); out3=0

sample_rate_dependence.stop_buffer: fixed 262144 samples; ~5.46s @ 48k, ~2.73s @ 96k (still covers 3s onset, below 1.5x headroom)

detail: gen~ DSL translation of tl_aux numpy reference; STOP/FILTER/FAIL modes share env_e and live in a single gen~ object; STOP buffers always written for state preservation across mode switches; FAIL outlet 3 emits e[n] consumed by tl_failure inlet 4 per Phase 1.5 contract.

interpolation_source: JOS Physical Audio Signal Processing - Lagrange Interpolation

lfo_norm_measurement.method: median(1/p99) across 8 seeds × 30 s of biquad-filtered noise sums at sr=44.1 kHz; matches numpy ref _build_lfo path (RBJ LPF + DF-I biquad with denormal flush + sum / n_bands)

sanity_checks: flutter=0 -> bit-identical passthrough (regression on round-1 invariant)
flutter=0.5 -> pitch p99 >= 18 c, AM pk-pk >= 1.0 dB (chord-noon audibility floor; numpy ref measures 20.1 c / 3.7 dB)
flutter=1.0 -> pitch p99 <= 50 c (under vibrato boundary; numpy ref measures 28.4 c)
flutter=1.0, classic_mode=1 -> AM bypassed; pitch path identical to non-classic
notes_for_integration: stub maxpat at device/tape-loss/tl_flutter.maxpat currently uses tapin~/tapout~ for the variable delay; this gen DSL absorbs the delay-line read into the codebox, so the integration agent should remove tapin~/tapout~ and the *~ AM multipliers and let the gen~ outlets feed the selector~ (or remove the selector~ since classic_mode is now internal).
buffer_sharing_strategy=private — shared [buffer~ tape_loss_delay] with tl_wow can be added later by replacing Delay declarations with Buffer references and coordinating offsets.
no tapin~ shared with tl_wow yet (Phase 1.5 reconciliation flag is unaddressed in v0); reference→Max output will not bit-match by design.

bypass_strategy_rationale: tl_model_eq.maxpat post-chain selector~ already routes filter_bypass at the audio layer; identity coefficients here keep biquad state clean and make model==0 transparent through the chain.
sample_rate_handling: inlet 2 int/float; defaults 44100; reemits coefficients on change
json_load_strategy: tries model_eq_coefficients.json then ../../data/... candidate paths via Max File API; on failure post()s error and emits identity coefficients to keep audio alive

pink_method_rationale: design doc section 2.1 explicitly specifies Voss-McCartney; section 8 tradeoff log notes 'VM win on transparency' over the cascade alternative

algorithm.hiss_path: voss_mccartney_16bin -> RBJ HPF 50 Hz Q=0.7071 -> RBJ LPF 12 kHz Q=0.7071 (Direct Form I); per-channel decorrelated noise() streams
algorithm.mech_vcr_path: white -> RBJ LPF 200 Hz Q=0.9 -> cascaded 1-pole AM @ 0.6 Hz; per-channel decorrelated
algorithm.mech_hum_path: 6-harmonic sine bank @ 60 Hz with relative amps [1.00, 0.30, 0.45, 0.18, 0.22, 0.12] for h=[1,2,3,4,5,7]; mono-correlated
algorithm.bipolar_crossfade: linear with hard silent center: vcr_w=max(0,0.5-ml)*2, hum_w=max(0,ml-0.5)*2, common_gain=max(vcr_w,hum_w)^2 * 10^(-40/20)
algorithm.mode_gate: hiss_on=(noise_mode>=1); mech_on=(noise_mode==2)&&!hum_bypass; OFF short-circuits output=input bit-exactly
algorithm.hum_normalize: fixed 1/2.27 (sum-of-|amps|) -- divergence from numpy ref's per-buffer peak normalize, documented in header
algorithm.vcr_normalize: fixed gain 7.0 -- divergence from numpy ref's per-buffer peak normalize, documented in header

expected_behavior.both_mech_0p5: silent mechanical, hiss only (hard silent center)

divergences_from_numpy_ref: VCR-LPF post-normalization uses fixed gain (7.0) instead of per-buffer peak; runtime-required.
Hum harmonic stack uses fixed 1/2.27 normalization instead of per-buffer peak normalize; runtime-required.
VCR slow-AM uses cascaded 1-pole at 0.6 Hz instead of target-redraw walk in [0.3,1.5] Hz; equivalent character (slow random ebb/flow), not bit-identical.
PSU half-wave-rect not applied as a runtime DSP step (numpy ref does not either); the half-wave character is baked into the harmonic amplitude table per design-doc section 3.2.
